in_sanskrit.name: शुभम्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shubam is derived from the Sanskrit word शुभ (shubh), which means 'auspicious, propitious, fortunate, blessed'. It is a name that is often used to bestow good fortune upon a child.

in_hindi.name: शुभम

in_tamil.name: ஷுபம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Shubam is derived from the Tamil word சுபம் (cubam), which is a borrowing of the Sanskrit word शुभम् (shubham). It means 'auspicious, propitious, fortunate, blessed'.

in_marathi.name: Shubam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shubam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shubh means auspicious, and Am means prosperity. The name Shubam is a combination of these two words and signifies a person who is blessed with good fortune and prosperity.
